name: Svipall
title_zh: 本地破墙抓网页，验证码不劳你亲手填
tagline_zh: 被 Cloudflare 拦、要爬整站、想按结构读页面、盯变化——Shell 里一条命令全干。验证码在本地解。
tagline_en: Blocked page? Whole-site crawl? Read as structure, not prose? Watch for changes? One shell command. Captchas.
desc_en: Fetch, crawl, search and extract any web page from the shell, getting past anti-bot walls and captchas locally. Use when a page is blocked, when a site needs crawling, when a page has to be read as structure rather than prose, or when a change needs watching over time.
why_zh: 别人把抓取外包给云端，它把反爬破解留在本机——验证码识别、指纹伪装都在本地跑，页面不出你机器。
why_en: Others outsource scraping to the cloud; Svipall keeps anti-bot and captcha-solving on your machine. Pages never leave your box.
limit_zh: 只认静态 HTML 和常见反爬（Cloudflare 基础层等）。
limit_en: Handles static HTML and basic anti-bot (e.g. Cloudflare's first layer). Heavy JS SPAs need a headless browser. Only image captchas.
title_en: Fetch any web page past anti-bot walls, locally
